# apple_build_bundle_file_sizes (Data Source)

Lists the download and install sizes of a build bundle per device model and OS version, for example to check an app's size before release.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_build_bundle_file_sizes" "app" {
  build_bundle_id = data.apple_build_bundles.latest.build_bundles[0].id
}

# Fail the plan when the universal download grows past 200 MB.
check "download_size" {
  assert {
    condition = alltrue([
      for size in data.apple_build_bundle_file_sizes.app.file_sizes : size.download_bytes < 200 * 1024 * 1024
      if size.device_model == "Universal"
    ])
    error_message = "The app's universal download is larger than 200 MB."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_bundle_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build bundle; see `data.apple_build_bundles`.

### Read-Only

- `file_sizes` (Attributes List) The sizes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file_sizes))

<a id="nestedatt--file_sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `file_sizes`

Read-Only:

- `device_model` (String) Device model the size is for, e.g. `iPhone18,1`, or `Universal`.
- `download_bytes` (Number) Size of the download in bytes.
- `install_bytes` (Number) Size once installed, in bytes.
- `os_version` (String) OS version the size is for, or `Universal`.
